plain: A false, damaging remark about a person's good name

webster.text: A sprinkling, as of water or dust, in a literal sense.

more.text: The spreading of calumnious reports or charges, which tarnish reputation, like the bespattering of a body with foul water.

example.quote: I hope we shall hear no more of such groundless aspersions.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 11, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
